description: This file implements the request processing functions for a HyperText Transfer Protocol (HTTP) client, including various methods like GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, TRACE, OPTIONS, CONNECT, and functions for custom request line processing. It handles initiating HTTP transactions, managing web session objects, and optional authentication handling.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS HttpScoRequest(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ULONG ulMethod,ANSC_HANDLE hReqUri,ANSC_HANDLE hReqContext,BOOL bUseTls)
methods.description: Initiates a HTTP transaction by selecting an existing or creating a new web client session object and calling its Request method with provided parameters.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS HttpScoRequest2(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,char * request_line,ANSC_HANDLE hReqContext)
methods.description: Parses a raw HTTP request line string, determines if HTTPS is needed, then initiates a request with the parsed method and URI.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS HttpScoRequest3(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ULONG ulMethod,ANSC_HANDLE hReqUri,ANSC_HANDLE hReqContext,BOOL bUseTls,char * pUserName,char * pPassword)
methods.description: Similar to HttpScoRequest but includes support for user authentication credentials and sets up necessary auth interfaces before requesting.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS HttpScoDoOptions(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hReqUri,ANSC_HANDLE hReqContext,BOOL bUseTls)
methods.description: Performs an HTTP OPTIONS request on the specified URI.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS HttpScoDoGet(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hReqUri,ANSC_HANDLE hReqContext,BOOL bUseTls)
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request on the specified URI.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS HttpScoDoHead(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hReqUri,ANSC_HANDLE hReqContext,BOOL bUseTls)
methods.description: Performs an HTTP HEAD request on the specified URI.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS HttpScoDoPost(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hReqUri,ANSC_HANDLE hReqContext,BOOL bUseTls)
methods.description: Performs an HTTP POST request on the specified URI.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS HttpScoDoPut(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hReqUri,ANSC_HANDLE hReqContext,BOOL bUseTls)
methods.description: Performs an HTTP PUT request on the specified URI.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS HttpScoDoDelete(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hReqUri,ANSC_HANDLE hReqContext,BOOL bUseTls)
methods.description: Performs an HTTP DELETE request on the specified URI.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS HttpScoDoTrace(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hReqUri,ANSC_HANDLE hReqContext,BOOL bUseTls)
methods.description: Performs an HTTP TRACE request on the specified URI.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS HttpScoDoConnect(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hReqUri,ANSC_HANDLE hReqContext,BOOL bUseTls)
methods.description: Performs an HTTP CONNECT request, typically to establish a tunnel.
